headline: Drones spotted over German military base after Leipzig bombing
summary: Police are investigating drone sightings over a German base reportedly linked to Patriot missile-system parts.
script: Police are investigating drones spotted over a German military base days after a bombing in Leipzig. The base reportedly houses parts for Patriot missile systems, raising fresh security questions.
